newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SOCCER-CROATS HELP BRUGGE BEAT SCHALKE IN THE SNOW.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CROATS HELP BRUGGE BEAT SCHALKE IN THE SNOW.

text.p: Belgian side Club Brugge made the better of wintry conditions on Tuesday to beat Schalke 04 of Germany 2-1 thanks to goals from their two Croatian players.
While both sides struggled to string passes together on a snow-covered pitch, Schalke had the best of the early exchanges in the first leg of their UEFA Cup third round tie.
But Brugge took the lead against the run of play, Croatian forward Mario Stanic heading home in the 35th minute after a defensive blunder by the visitors.

Michael Bueskens put the Germans back on terms early in the second half with a spectacular half-volley from a corner kick, seconds after Brugge goalkeeper Dany Verlinden had saved a penalty with his legs.

Brugge's second Croatian, Robert Spehar, restored his side's lead eight minutes later, stroking the ball home from six metres when the ball fell at his feet after a three-pass move inside the penalty area.
Schalke take the consolation of an away goal into the second leg in a fortnight's time.
